# aptabase Provider

Manages apps, app shares, and API keys on a self-hosted [aptabase-plus](https://github.com/nmehlei/aptabase-plus) instance.

~> This provider does **not** work against Aptabase Cloud or stock self-hosted Aptabase - only against `aptabase-plus`, which adds the API-key-authenticated management API this provider depends on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "aptabase" {
  endpoint = "https://aptabase.example.com"
  # token falls back to the APTABASE_TOKEN environment variable
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the aptabase-plus instance, e.g. `https://aptabase.example.com`.

### Optional

- `insecure` (Boolean) Allow a plain-HTTP endpoint. Only for local development against a disposable instance - never set this against a production endpoint.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API key for the aptabase-plus management API. Falls back to the `APTABASE_TOKEN` environment variable when unset; configuration fails if neither is present.
